name: Recreational area (brown)
spec: brown horizontal rectangle with white legend STATE PARK and a white arrow
meaning: Points to parks and recreation areas.

snippets.back: Brown and white guide signs mark points of public recreational or cultural interest.
Wind is very dangerous for campers, large recreational vehicles and anyone towing a trailer, and it also makes lightweight vehicles harder to control.

Colorado law requires you to yield to a truck, bus, emergency vehicle or recreational vehicle entering, leaving or driving in a roundabout, and when two such large vehicles meet there, the one on the right yields to the one on the left.
Brown signs identify recreational sites and cultural attractions.
Recreation signs generally have white lettering against brown.

An owned vehicle requires Florida registration, a license plate, and a Florida title unless held by an out-of-state lienholder; non-residents who start work or enroll children in Florida public school have ten days to register with Florida insurance and title proof, and out-of-state vehicles need vehicle identification number verification except new vehicles, new or used mobile homes, trailer-type recreational vehicles, and trailers or semitrailers under two thousand pounds.

Guide and information signs cover everything about your location and the location of places and services, including route markers, location and distance signs, park and recreation signs, and service information signs.
Brown guides you to recreation and cultural points of interest such as parks and historic sites.

result.summary: Meaning supported as pointing to parks/recreation; colour brown with white supported but rectangle/ STATE PARK legend/arrow shape details never stated.
